Omni-STEM Evaluation Document
Testing Polymorphic JSON Extraction & Hybrid Routing
Testing Objective: This document tests the Intelligent Ingestion Engine and the polymorphic
Vision JSON schema. It contains pure digital text alongside three distinct visual domains
(Mathematical, Biological, and Electrical) to verify that the Vision-Language Model dynamically
adapts its extraction strategy and does not hallucinate overlapping properties (e.g., axes on circuit
diagrams). 
1. Mathematical Data Visualization
This first section introduces a quantitative bar chart designed to test the bar_chart schema pathway.
The model should accurately extract the numeric values from the y-axis and map them to their
corresponding discrete categories on the x-axis without attempting to detect physical wires or spatial
nodes.

2. Biological Systems Diagram
The biological diagram below tests the system's ability to extract structural nodes and anatomical
labels using the biology schema. The visual portrays a simplified eukaryotic animal cell featuring an
external cell membrane, a central nucleus, and mitochondria. The system should correctly identify
these spatial nodes and their relative locations.
3. Electrical Circuit Schematic
This final section evaluates the circuit_diagram extraction logic. The diagram represents a closed-
loop electronic system. A 9V Direct Current (DC) source provides potential difference, pushing
current through a 100Ω current-limiting resistor (R1) and a Light Emitting Diode (LED1). The VLM
must accurately construct a graph of these components and their wire connections.
